critical_code_review_comments: Note: /app/frontend/public/index.html still loads https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js. The 'Made with Emergent' badge text is NOT rendered in the DOM body (test confirmed absent), but the loader script is still present in the HTML. If the requirement is to completely remove the Emergent branding *script reference*, this <script> tag should be removed from index.html. Currently the visible branding is gone as required.
Booking.jsx iframe uses loading='lazy' which delays load until near viewport — fine, but consider 'eager' since the iframe IS the primary CTA on /reservation.
reservations.py routes catch generic Exception and surface raw str(e) at 500 — fine for now, but could leak internal details; consider mapping ValidationError → 422 explicitly.
Reservation.jsx (legacy /contact route) still exists with its own form posting to /api/reservations; consistent with backend but duplicates booking UX with the Agenda.ch widget.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a TEST_AutomatedUser reservation as part of CRUD test (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is in French; booking page is /reservation (not /booking). Agenda.ch iframe is an external 3rd-party widget — do NOT try to interact inside it (cross-origin). Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_kryzalid_api.py — reuse it. Email validator rejects .test TLD, use @example.com for test data. /api/reservations PATCH takes status as QUERY param, not body.
